as_told.title: Coulthart on the MJ12 document's 28 June 1961 date

plain: MJ12, or Majestic 12, is a set of papers said to describe a secret group that handled UFO matters for the US government. The podcast host Jesse Michels points to one of these papers, leaked in 1995. He says it records a top secret request from President John F. Kennedy to Allen Dulles, then head of the CIA, dated 28 June 1961. He notes that journalist Ross Coulthart discussed it on the TV channel NewsNation with Jeff Krushank, a former Australian intelligence officer. As they tell it, a diary of Dulles's released in 2022 shows the same date, which would suggest the paper is real. Coulthart tells it himself on the same episode, stressing that the MJ12 files are heavily disputed.
